observations:
Torah #7 yields 5 well-defined packages from its 28 bechina edges covering 36 nodes. All packages are local to Torah #7 as required by the framework. No new cross-Torah super-categories are needed or appropriate. The 5 packages map cleanly onto the Torah's four-part argument structure:

Argument flow (eitza chains between packages):
  [Pkg 2: Yosef/Tzitzit — good]
       ↓ eitza: tzitzit protects from serpent's counsel
  [Pkg 3: Holy Counsel — neutral/good]
       ↑ eitza: enables emet, emunah
  [Pkg 1: Emunah/Tefilla — good]
       ↑ eitza: leads to
  [Redemption — no package, eitza endpoint]

Evil mirror structure:
  Pkg 1 (Emunah) ←→ Pkg 5 (Shikcha/Forgetting)
  Pkg 3 (Holy Counsel) ←→ Pkg 4 (Serpent's Counsel)
  Pkg 2 (Yosef/Tzitzit) has no explicit evil mirror in the bechina data (Ham/Canaan appear in eitza edges only)

No concepts were found in the source text that demand a wholly new package type beyond those identified. The 5 packages are sufficient and complete for this Torah.
